title: Avoid even small hints of violence in your Seedance/Adobe Firefly prompt to…
content: Avoid even small hints of violence in your Seedance/Adobe Firefly prompt to prevent safety rejections; use non-violent alternatives (e.g., “astronauts with angel wings”) to get accepted.
tips: Avoid even small hints of violence in your Seedance/Adobe Firefly prompt to prevent safety rejections; use non-violent alternatives (e.g., “astronauts with angel wings”) to get accepted.

es.content:
Evita incluso pequeños indicios de violencia en tu prompt de Seedance/Adobe Firefly para prevenir rechazos de seguridad; usa alternativas no violentas (por ejemplo, “astronautas con alas de ángel”) para que sea aceptado.

ja.content:
Seedance/Adobe Firefly の prompt では、たとえ小さな暴力表現でも避けてください。安全性による拒否を防ぐため、代わりに非暴力的な表現（例：「天使の翼を持つ宇宙飛行士」）を使うと承認されやすくなります。
